ai_summary: Amanta Healthcare Limited has filed a notice with stock exchanges and mailed letters to shareholders regarding its upcoming 31st Annual General Meeting for FY 2025-26 and the online availability of its Annual Report. Materially, the document stresses the urgent need for shareholders, particularly those with physical holdings, to update their KYC details as mandated by SEBI, as non-compliance will restrict future payments (e.g., dividends) to electronic mode only from April 1, 2024. This filing is routine for regulatory compliance and does not present any financial red flags.
